content: अनुग {%a.%} [अनुगच्छतीति, गम्-ड] (In <ab>comp.</ab>) Following, going after; corresponding or tallying with, adequate to; सदा पृष्ठानुगः पुरे <ls>Pt. 1. 59</ls>; गीतानुगं वारि मृदङ्गवाद्यम् <ls>R. 16. 64</ls>; <ls>Me. 47</ls>; कामक्रोधवशानुगम् <ls>Ms. 2. 214</ls>; गोत्ररिक्थानुगः पिण्डः <ls n="Ms.">9. 142</ls> governed or regulated by; <ls n="Ms.">8. 239</ls>. .{@-गः@} A follower, (obedient) servant, companion; तद्भूतनाथानुग <ls>R. 2. 58</ls>, <ls n="R.">9. 82</ls>; बल˚ followed by an army, being the head of an army.
